item.title: Tate McRae
item.description: Tate McRae ended her Miss Possessive Tour with a bang last weekend. On Nov 7, she performed her final show at the Kia Forum. This was her third sold-out show at the venue, as she added the date to the tour after playing two shows there earlier in the year. With 83 shows, it was McRae’s biggest tour to date and her first arena tour. item.title: BTS Announces Massive 2026–2027 Global World Tour
item.description: BTS is officially back on the road! The K-pop superstars have announced a massive world tour spanning 2026 and 2027, marking their long-awaited return to the stage as a full seven-member group. With nearly 80 shows across five continents, this tour promises to be one of the biggest in BTS history.The tour kicks off on April 9, 2026, in Goyang, South Korea, and wraps up in Manila, Philippines, in March 2027.
